# `Q-5-44` — book-scope Is Not a Format Option

> `book-scope` was set under `format:` and ignored.

## What this means

`book-scope` is read only at the top level of a metadata layer. Which format a render uses depends on the requested scope (a whole-book render uses the project's formats), so a scope that depends on the format would be circular.

## How to fix

Move `book-scope` out of `format:` to the top level of the same file.
